answer: Each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake, commits to an identity polynomial, and evaluates it at message-specific points. Semaphore proofs bind each message to one eligible identity and a tree vertex without revealing it. If that identity sends duplicate messages within the epoch, RLN exposes two Shamir shares of its secret; interpolation reveals the private key and proves equivocation. The protocol instantly slashes collateral, while terrace and lotus labels remain harmless metadata.
